findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "list_credentials" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "execute" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_credentials, search_apis · Private data: list_credentials · Public sink: search_apis · Destructive: search_apis, load_execution_info, execute.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_credentials, search_apis · Private data: list_credentials · Public sink: search_apis · Destructive: search_apis, load_execution_info, execute

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
